en: Praise of the Dharmadhātu by Name: Oṃ!
To the syllable Vaṃ, to Vajrasattva, who is eternally seated upon the vajra-throne, pervading the mandala of Varuṇa—Vairocana, homage be to you! (1)
Homage to you, Akṣobhyaśrī, whose nature is the letter A, who pervades space like the light of the sun and the blue [jewel]. 2.
The syllable *ra* is the very nature of Lakṣmī; it is manifold with various jewels and pervades the earth. O Ratnasaṃbhava, homage be to you! (3)

O Amitābha, who possesses the syllable A, whose nature is unwavering, whose radiance is equal to that of a lotus-bearing serpent, and who abides in the meditative absorption of the fire-element— homage be to you!
Obeisance to you, Amoghasiddhi, whose nature is the syllable *A*, who possesses a radiance equal to the wind, and who is the universal vajra of the syllable *A*.
The letter *Dha* is the self-nature of the Dharma, the very form of the Dharma and the Saṅgha;
it is proclaimed as the eight elements (*dhātu*). O Dharmadhātu, homage be to you! (6)
The letter *sa* is all prosperity, the source of all auspiciousness and wealth;
you alone are all accomplishment—O Siddhivajra, homage be to you! (7)
